primary: delta .01 selective versus Gray and Radau; all 48 independent channel clusters

bootstrap.unit: condition/channel seed; average all frames and waveforms inside each cluster

quality_transfer: Both frozen validation-selected methods must satisfy test cluster mean <= q and P90 cluster mean <= q_tail.
empirical_equivalence: Additionally require the 95% paired cluster bootstrap CI of mean disagreement difference to lie wholly inside [-q/2,q/2], and absolute P90 cluster difference <= q_tail/2. This practical tolerance is predeclared, not a proof of equal distribution.
unmatched: Retain raw costs and quality; no same-quality speedup ratio. Say quality matching did not transfer.
subgroups: Four channel clusters per condition: descriptive only; no subgroup significance claims.
tails: Report empirical P50/P90/P95/P99 frame work and CPU; do not treat correlated bits or waveforms as independent samples.
cpu: End-to-end receiver setup+solve timings; randomized deterministic method rotation; no claim of hardware latency. Preparation timing varies across independent rebuilds.
caps: All failed or unknown requests remain in every cost and BER denominator. No fallback. No test retuning.
